The '''Marquis''' was a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] model produced by [[Korrealis Systems]] during or after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Korrealis Marquis was first added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'', a [[2015]] expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as one of the items in the Anarchist's Alliance Pack.

*[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] {{1st}}
